description: A document that declares jos.version 1.0.0 and asks for a sandbox. It runs `execution.run`, a 2.0 member (SPEC-2.0 §6.8): it is valid under SPEC-2.0 (a 1.0.x version is read as in §2.4 and validated with schema/jos.schema.json) and not under the 1.0.0 schema, which has no executable atom; tier-sandbox-1.0.0-flow is the genuine 1.0.0 case. It is unexecutable in a runtime that cannot confine it (§6.5, Appendix C). A runtime that confines the step runs it instead, and its receipt records isolation "sandbox" (alternative).
